title: Ultimate Pickaxe
description: A pickaxe that makes a 3x3 hole in the direction you are mining. Its like the drill in DonutSmp
body: The Ultimate Pickaxe is a custom Netherite Pickaxe which allows you to mine a complete 3×3 grid of blocks based on the direction you are looking at. With it, you can mine blocks way faster than with a regular Pickaxe. The Drill comes with enchantments like Efficiency V, which gives you a faster mining speed, along with Unbreaking V which makes the pickaxe extremely durable, and Mending which allows the tool to repair itself through XP.
